Woman Dies by Suicide in Delhi, Video Alleges Abuse

A 24-year-old woman has died by suicide in Delhi's Nangloi area. Police recovered a video from her mobile phone in which she reportedly detailed alleged harassment by her in-laws. She also expressed concern for her 1.5-year-old daughter.
